objective: Test whether a zero-parameter internal side-head directional-consistency rule improves the stability of side-target boundary proposals without changing the frozen V3.2.4 projection operator.

mechanism_basis.allowed_inference: A side-target proposal should be considered structurally reliable only when the conditional H-vs-A side share itself moves toward that side target; proposals created only by draw-mass recombination are directionally inconsistent.

data.cohort_guard: No E2/E3/SC1/SC2/SC3 row from these seasons was used in the first two external projection diagnostics.

proxy_mapping.raw_side_proposal: opening Top1 differs from closing Top1 AND closing Top1 is H or A
proxy_mapping.side_consistency_rule: For H target require closing_side_share > opening_side_share; for A target require closing_side_share < opening_side_share. Equality is inconsistent. No fitted epsilon or threshold.
proxy_mapping.draw_target: excluded from both always-side comparator and candidate because this diagnostic targets the non-draw side head and frozen V3.2.4 had zero D switch targets.
proxy_mapping.weak_side: argmin of opening H-vs-A only; draw is never weak side
proxy_mapping.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening fallback

comparators.always_side_project: apply exact V3.2.4 projection to every raw H/A target proposal
comparators.side_head_consistent: apply exact V3.2.4 projection only to raw H/A target proposals passing the frozen conditional-side-share direction rule

interpretation_guards: This is a structural proxy experiment for T2 direction-generation reliability, not an out-of-domain V3.2.4 football-model evaluation.
Closing odds are never added to football3 production or to the formal research model.
If this cohort fails, no threshold or league exception may be derived from it.
If it passes, the rule may only become a pre-frozen hypothesis for future fresh Big-5 confirmation.
The quarantined 2026/27 Big-5 97-match snapshot remains unopened by this experiment.
